test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In the following sentence the underlined part contains an error. Alternatives to the underlined part are given as options. Select the correct alternative.

The table looks __proper __in the centre than in the corner.
solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. more proper .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence compares two positions of the table: in the centre and in the corner.
 
• When making comparisons, the word "proper" should be modified correctly to reflect the comparative degree.
 
• The word "proper" is a two-syllable adjective, so the correct comparative form is "more proper" rather than "properer" or "most proper".

Correct sentence: *The table looks **more proper** in the centre than in the corner*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Comparative Adjectives:**

 
 
• **Structure:** Adjective + "-er" or "more" + Adjective.
 
• **Example:** taller (for one-syllable words), more beautiful (for multi-syllable words).
 
• **Usage: **Used to compare differences between two objects or people.
 
 
 
• **Superlative Adjectives:**
 
 
• **Structure: **Adjective + "-est" or "most" + Adjective.
 
• **Example: **tallest (for one-syllable words), most beautiful (for multi-syllable words).
 
• **Usage: **Used to compare more than two objects or people, indicating the highest degree of the quality.
